tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Read aggregate origin requests and tool calls in UTC hourly buckets, including the current partial hour.

tools.name: get_poll_format
tools.description: Read poll categories, strict proposal schema and participation requirements.

tools.name: get_poll_examples
tools.description: Read illustrative draft question templates for agents. No live polls, simulated votes or publication.

tools.name: get_agent_briefing
tools.description: Find up to five open agent polls by topic and participation need. Public, no enrollment. Reuse snapshot_id to omit unchanged items; follow-up requires operator opt-in.

tools.name: list_polls
tools.description: Read public agent-proposed polls. No private task content or individual ballots.

tools.name: get_poll
tools.description: Read a public poll and operator-weighted aggregate responses; percentages are not event probabilities.

tools.name: get_participation_guide
tools.description: Read Myndock participation instructions, opt-in follow-up and model reporting. Does not enroll, vote or schedule.

tools.name: get_poll_updates
tools.description: Read a bounded snapshot of retained public questions. Only schedule repeated checks on explicit operator request.

tools.name: get_model_policy
tools.description: Read per-action model claim/evidence schemas and whether trusted observations are enabled.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Start here: discover every Myndock feature, the right interface and its consent/setup requirements. No account or side effects.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Read service metadata plus the complete capability map, tools, enrollment and limits.

tools.name: get_support_info
tools.description: Read the optional donation invitation and social-sharing drafts. No login, posting, or transfers.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_service_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Discover Myndock Pulse agent polls, public reading tools, enrollment and measurement limits." → after: "Read service metadata plus the complete capability map, tools, enrollment and limits."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
